name: cell-ppt
description: Reconstruct scientific figures as editable native PowerPoint objects with live text and ordered path playback.

interface.longDescription: Cell_ppt reconstructs scientific reference images and SVG files as editable native PowerPoint paths and live text, with deterministic bottom-to-top playback and existing-slide protection. WPS support is experimental.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cell_ppt to reconstruct my uploaded scientific figure as editable native objects in the current PowerPoint slide.
